---
title: "Brain Summary"
---

in this document i will compare the total number of genes regionally elevated expression in different regions of the forebrain for human, pig and mouse.

human
```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180, 162, 83, 57)
print(total_elevated_human)
```

pig
```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109, 165, 157, 31)
print(total_elevated_pig)
```

mouse
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55, 182, 185, 60)
print(total_elevated_mouse)
```

both mice and human have the highest number of genes with elevated expression, 482.
